messages:
zoe: Brainstorm: small PLG test — 1 LinkedIn post + 30-min demo + 72h staggered credits. Hypothesis: staggered credits (1000 immediate + 2k on first prompt run) increase activation vs one-time 3k. We A/B the narrative (outcome vs trust) and route signups to tailored prompt packs. Thoughts?
ben: Love it. Metrics: signup->first_prompt_time, activated_72h, pct_using_prompt_pack. Can analytics add cohort labels?
ivy: Copy ideas — outcome: 'Ship predictable, cost-aware LLM features fast.' trust: 'Used by teams with strict SLAs and private deploys.' CTAs: 'Grab starter credits' & 'See short demo'.
tilly_sdr: SDR workflow: qualify company emails with >=1k tokens in 7d -> hot queue. Otherwise, auto-nurture email + product tips. SLA: 4h for hot leads.
ops-bot: Routing rule queued. Example payload: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/route -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"{{email}}","utm":"staggerA"}' -> assigns cohort=staggerA.
zoe: Onboarding artifact: two prompt packs (outcome_pack, trust_pack). Each pack = 3 templates: assistant, retrieval, summary + short example. Place in /docs/prompt-templates/stagger-launch-1766666001.md
ben: Analytics: emit events 'credit_grant' (amount, cohort) and 'prompt_pack_download' with cohort so we can tie to activation funnel.
ops-bot: Tracking snippet: <script>track('prompt_pack_download',{cohort:'staggerA'});</script> and <script>emit('credit_grant',{cohort:'staggerA',amount:1000});</script>
ivy: Draft posts: outcome: 'Build LLM features with predictable latency and unit cost 15 min demo + starter credits.' trust: 'Enterprise-ready inference that keeps your data in your VPC. Quick demo + credits.'
zoe: Timeline: copy + landing by Wed noon, routing live Thu, demo Fri 11am PT, credits live on signup. Ben will publish dashboard by Thu PM. Any blockers?
ben: Dashboard mock uploaded to /drive/marketing/stagger-1766/dashboard.png. No blockers.
tilly_sdr: Need hidden field 'use_case' on signup and a short dropdown to prioritize outreach.
zoe: Good call. Also include a tiny survey after first prompt run: 'Did this output help you?' yes/no. We'll use it as a qualitative signal.
ops-bot: Webhook created to post qualified leads to #sales-inbound.
zoe: Okay team — I'll draft the two landing variants and attach link here. Please flag copy edits. :sparkles:
